about: PoE 1 league-economy history (33 challenge leagues, Essence 2016 -> Allflame 2026) from poe.ninja's public economy dumps, used as ANALOGY for Path of Exile 2. Nothing here is PoE 2 fact; each law carries a poe2_check against research/market (PoE 2 exchange data, 3 launches). Prices: poe.ninja daily values in Chaos; curves in top-orb terms (Exalted before 3.19 Kalandra, Divine from Kalandra on), relative to league day 1 unless the group name says otherwise. Day 0 = launch Friday (partial). Item groups only use items worth 5c+ on day 1 (below that, listings sit on a ~1c floor).

laws.law: Chaos per top orb (Exalted before 3.19, Divine after) rises at least 1.2x from day 1 to day 14.
laws.poe2_mapping: PoE 1 Chaos:top-orb <-> PoE 2 Ex:Div (everyday currency vs the store of value).
laws.poe2_evidence: PoE 2 Ex per Div d1->d14: Fate of the Vaal 92.0->403.3, Runes of Aldur 51.5->131.8, Forbidden Rites 84.1->474.9
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: The ratio's biggest single jump is week 1: day 7 is at least 1.4x day 1.
laws.poe2_mapping: Same pair as above.
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: The ratio does NOT peak in week 1: its (3-day smoothed) high over days 1-70 comes on day 10 or later.
laws.poe2_mapping: Same pair.
laws.poe2_evidence: PoE 2 Ex per Div peaked on d14 (FotV), d42 (RoA), d42 (FR).
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: The ratio's peak is 1.8x-4x its day-1 value (a 2-3x rise is typical).
laws.poe2_mapping: Same pair; the SIZE is where the analogy breaks.
laws.poe2_evidence: PoE 2 Ex per Div rose 4.4x / 10.7x / 8.4x from d1 to peak: Exalted Orbs deflate far harder than PoE 1 Chaos.
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: Late slide: the last 7 days of the league trade at least 10% below the day 1-70 ratio peak.
laws.poe2_mapping: Same pair.
laws.poe2_evidence: PoE 2 Ex per Div fell 25-34% from peak by week 10-11 in all three (FR 709->468 by d77; RoA 553->375 at d70, but back to 506-544 at d108-119).
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: The everyday currency loses at least 40% against the top orb by day 14 (Chaos Orb priced in Ex/Div).
laws.poe2_mapping: PoE 1 Chaos <-> PoE 2 Exalted Orb.
laws.poe2_evidence: PoE 2 Exalted lost 53-79% of its Div value by d6 and 83-92% by d28 (stronger than PoE 1).
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: Mirror of Kalandra keeps rising in top-orb terms: day 42 is at least 1.5x day 7.
laws.poe2_mapping: PoE 1 Mirror <-> PoE 2 Mirror (and the other pure sinks: Hinekora's Lock).
laws.poe2_evidence: PoE 2 Mirror in Div d6->d42: Fate of the Vaal 23.075x, Runes of Aldur 3.641x, Forbidden Rites 2.428x; Hinekora's Lock d1->d42 Fate of the Vaal 65.423x, Runes of Aldur 20.39x, Forbidden Rites 20.533x
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)
laws.note: Mirror quotes before day 7 are troll listings; Kalandra dropped (bad quotes). PoE 2 Mirror d6->d42 is similar in the 0.5 leagues (2.4-3.6x) and 23x in 0.4 (Divine-rich temple farming).

laws.law: Common currency (Alchemy, Fusing, Chromatic, Alteration, Jeweller's, Regal, Chance, Scouring, Vaal...) is worth at most 60% of its day-1 top-orb value by day 42.
laws.poe2_mapping: PoE 1 basic orbs <-> PoE 2 Transmute/Aug/Regal/Alch lines and Greater/Lesser orbs.
laws.poe2_evidence: PoE 2 Greater Exalted -93/-93/-96% by d21; Transmute/Aug/Regal/Alch lines -82 to -99% by d42.
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: Common currency just tracks the Chaos Orb: its top-orb curve at day 42 is within 35% of the Chaos Orb's own.
laws.poe2_mapping: PoE 1 basic orbs vs Chaos <-> PoE 2 basic orbs vs Exalted.
laws.poe2_evidence: In PoE 2 the basic orbs crash 80-99% in Div while Ex loses 83-92%: similar by d28-42 but basic orbs fall FASTER in week 1 (Greater Jeweller's -96 to -99% by d14). PoE 1 basic orbs barely move in Chaos.
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: Breach/Timeless/Simulacrum SPLINTERS crash: at most 30% of their day-1 top-orb value by day 42.
laws.poe2_mapping: PoE 1 splinters <-> PoE 2 Breach Splinter / Simulacrum Splinter.
laws.poe2_evidence: PoE 2 Breach Splinter d1->d42: {"Fate of the Vaal": 5.189, "Runes of Aldur": 0.599, "Forbidden Rites": 5.039}; Simulacrum Splinter: {"Fate of the Vaal": 1.888, "Runes of Aldur": 0.522, "Forbidden Rites": 1.283} (flat to up, not a crash).
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: Pinnacle keys/fragments (Sacrifice/Mortal sets, Shaper/Elder fragments, Breachstones, Emblems, Writs) fall with the Chaos Orb: at most 60% of their day-1 top-orb value by day 42.
laws.poe2_mapping: PoE 1 boss keys <-> PoE 2 pinnacle keys (Trialmaster Fates, Breachstone, Simulacrum).
laws.poe2_evidence: PoE 2 Victorious Fate d1->d42: {"Fate of the Vaal": 40.042, "Runes of Aldur": 30.284, "Forbidden Rites": 48.948}; Breachstone: {"Runes of Aldur": 1.12, "Forbidden Rites": 2.971}. PoE 2 keys mostly RISE in Div; PoE 1 keys are farmed in bulk and fall.
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: Scarabs (worth 5c+ on day 1) lose at least 30% of their top-orb value by day 42.
laws.poe2_mapping: PoE 1 scarabs <-> PoE 2 Precursor Tablets (map-juicing consumables).
laws.poe2_evidence: Tablets don't trade on the PoE 2 Currency Exchange, so research/market has no tablet curve.
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: Common essences (5c+ on day 1) lose at least 40% of their top-orb value by day 42.
laws.poe2_mapping: PoE 1 common essences <-> PoE 2 common/Greater essences.
laws.poe2_evidence: PoE 2 essence category -90% (RoA) / -89% (FR) by d42; FotV +38% (outlier).
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: Special essences (Hysteria, Insanity, Horror, Delirium) beat common essences by day 70 (higher top-orb ratio).
laws.poe2_mapping: PoE 1 corrupted essences <-> PoE 2 Essence of Delirium / Perfect Essence of the Infinite.
laws.poe2_evidence: PoE 2 Essence of Delirium rose 12x / 8x / 24x d1->d42; PoE 1 special essences only recover towards their day-1 level.
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: Blight oils (5c+ on day 1) lose at least 50% of their top-orb value by day 42.
laws.poe2_mapping: PoE 1 oils <-> PoE 2 liquid emotions (both: anoint/instil drops).
laws.poe2_evidence: PoE 2 Diluted and low-tier liquid emotions -96 to -99% by d14; category -98% (RoA), -95% (FR), -27% (FotV). PoE 1 oils crashed in 3.8-3.18 but have held since 3.19 (exceptions list), so PoE 2 looks like early-era PoE 1.
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: Fossils (5c+ on day 1) lose at least 30% of their top-orb value by day 42.
laws.poe2_mapping: PoE 1 fossils <-> PoE 2 crafting omens.
laws.poe2_evidence: PoE 2 weak omens -98 to -99% by d42 (fits), but top omens rose 3-91x (Whittling, Light, Annulment): PoE 2 crafting consumables split harder into winners and losers.
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: PoE 1 omens (3.24+) end week 6 at or above their day-1 top-orb value.
laws.poe2_mapping: PoE 1 omens <-> PoE 2 top crafting omens.
laws.poe2_evidence: PoE 2 Omen of Light 91x / 4.6x / 5.5x, Whittling 49x / 3x / 15x d1->d42; weak omens -98%. PoE 1 omens peak late (median day 53) and are back near day-1 value by day 70, but dip in between.
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: Delirium orbs (5c+ on day 1) are worth more in top-orb terms on day 42 than on day 1.
laws.poe2_mapping: PoE 1 Delirium orbs (map juicing) <-> PoE 2 has no direct item; nearest are Simulacrum / Delirium splinters.
laws.poe2_evidence: PoE 2 Simulacrum d1->d42: {"Runes of Aldur": 0.407, "Forbidden Rites": 0.869} (mixed).
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: Catalysts lose at least 40% of their top-orb value by day 42.
laws.poe2_mapping: PoE 1 catalysts <-> PoE 2 Refined catalysts.
laws.poe2_evidence: PoE 2 Refined Sibilant Catalyst: {"Runes of Aldur": 43.665, "Forbidden Rites": 41.733} (40x+ risers).
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: Chase uniques (the 8 dearest on day 3) beat the median unique (5c+) by at least 2x from day 3 to day 42 (top-orb terms): they hold value while ordinary uniques melt.
laws.poe2_mapping: PoE 1 Headhunter/Mageblood tier <-> PoE 2 chase uniques (and chase lineage gems).
laws.poe2_evidence: No PoE 2 unique curves exist (uniques are not on the exchange). Nearest PoE 2 analogue, chase lineage gems (Uhtred's Exodus 1.1->59 / 7->335 / 14->280 Div), rises far more, and scarce exchange sinks rise 5-90x.
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: Chase uniques stay within 0.5x-2x of their day-3 top-orb price at day 42 (no crash, no moon).
laws.poe2_mapping: Same.
laws.poe2_evidence: No PoE 2 unique curves.
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: Uniques (10c+) fall more in week 1 than in any later week (Chaos terms).
laws.poe2_mapping: PoE 1 uniques <-> PoE 2 uniques; tested on PoE 2 exchange items instead.
laws.poe2_evidence: PoE 2 median exchange item d1->d6 in Div: {"Fate of the Vaal": 0.946, "Runes of Aldur": 0.814, "Forbidden Rites": 0.831}; common drops halve within ~3 days. No PoE 2 unique data.
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: 'Week 2 crash' (folk claim): week 2 is the worst week for uniques (Chaos terms).
laws.poe2_mapping: Folk claim, tested.
laws.poe2_evidence: PoE 2 exchange: the drop is front-loaded (days 0-3), not week 2. The real week-2 effect is a SMALLER second leg.
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: Week 2 is still a down week for uniques (Chaos terms, median change < 0).
laws.poe2_mapping: PoE 1 uniques <-> PoE 2 common exchange drops.
laws.poe2_evidence: PoE 2 common drops keep falling to their floor by ~d14 (3/3); PoE 2 uniques not measured.
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: Early-spike uniques (biggest day-1 -> week-1 risers, a proxy for build enablers once the meta forms) are at least 20% below their peak (Chaos) by day 28.
laws.poe2_mapping: PoE 1 build-enabler uniques <-> PoE 2 meta items that spike in week 1 (Uncut Skill Gem L20, common soul cores).
laws.poe2_evidence: PoE 2: Soul Core of Tacati peaks ~d10 then -58 to -83% by d42; Uncut Skill Gem (L20) peaks d6-14, FotV -77% after. Same shape, different item class; no PoE 2 unique data.
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: Early-spike uniques peak by day 7 (true peak, searched over days 2-28) for most of them (> 50%).
laws.poe2_mapping: Same.
laws.poe2_evidence: PoE 2 week-1 spikers peak d6-14 (Uncut Skill Gem L20, Tacati ~d10): a little later.
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: New league-mechanic loot does NOT fall harder in its first week than older items over the same days (top-orb terms). The folk law 'mechanic loot crashes hardest in week 1' fails.
laws.poe2_mapping: PoE 1 new-mechanic items <-> PoE 2 items new in a launch.
laws.poe2_evidence: Consistent: it FAILS in PoE 2 too. Items new to the exchange d1->d6 in Div: RoA 0.859 vs old 0.788, FR 1.062 vs 0.814.
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)
laws.note: 'New' = item name never priced in an earlier league, first priced on days 1-7. The folk version (new loot falls harder) held in only the exception leagues.

laws.law: Weekend dip: item prices (10c+, Chaos) sit lower on Sat/Sun than Tue-Thu (days 8-63, detrended).
laws.poe2_mapping: PoE 1 weekend demand/supply <-> PoE 2 weekends.
laws.poe2_evidence: PoE 2 Forbidden Rites days 63-77 (two weekends only), residual % by weekday: {"Tue": 2.016, "Wed": 1.777, "Thu": -0.437, "Fri": -1.04, "Sat": 1.677, "Sun": -0.488, "Mon": 3.679} - too short to call.
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)
laws.early_leagues_effect: negative in most leagues up to Kalandra, positive from Ancestor on

laws.law: Weekend dip in the ratio: Chaos per top orb is lower on Sat/Sun than Tue-Thu (days 8-63, detrended).
laws.poe2_mapping: Same pair as the ratio laws.
laws.poe2_evidence: Not tested in PoE 2 (needs daily ratios beyond week 1).
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: End of league: uniques (10c+) are dearer in Chaos in the last 14 days than in the 14 before.
laws.poe2_mapping: PoE 1 thin end-of-league markets <-> PoE 2 late league (volume down 65-98% by week 6-10).
laws.poe2_evidence: PoE 2 late-league unique prices not measured; exchange risers plateau or dip after ~d56 (e.g. Omen of Light).
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)

laws.law: 'Rich get richer': items dearer on day 1 gain more (or lose less) by day 42 (Spearman rho > 0).
laws.poe2_mapping: PoE 1 item/currency cross-section <-> PoE 2 exchange cross-section.
laws.poe2_evidence: Same sign but much stronger in PoE 2: rho d1->d6 = Fate of the Vaal 0.269, Runes of Aldur 0.118, Forbidden Rites 0.184; curve items d1->d42 pooled rho 0.368.
laws.label: PoE 1 history (analogy for PoE 2, not PoE 2 fact)
laws.note: PoE 1 day-1 prices are poe.ninja LISTING prices and over-shoot (day-1 asks revert); PoE 2 data are executed exchange trades.

hype.index: Steam peak players in the launch month / median of the previous 3 launches (SteamCharts; Steam is only part of PoE's players, the standalone client is not counted).

sources.title: poe.ninja PoE 1 economy data dumps (CC-BY-SA), one zip per league
sources.note: 33 zips, 1.1 GB, cached raw on F:\Research-cache\poe1\zips; slimmed copies in cache/slim.

sources.title: SteamCharts: Path of Exile (app 238960) monthly peak players
Exile Oracle PoE 2 market study (research/market/market-trends.json, sources.md)
Exile Oracle app DB (read-only): ls_price days 0-6 of 3 launches, ex_price FR days 63-77
Checked, not used (derived from the same poe.ninja dumps or not a dataset): Kaggle 'Path of Exile currency economy', github produdez/poe-economy, poeledger

caveats: ANALOGY ONLY: PoE 1 uses player-to-player trade with listing prices; PoE 2 has a Currency Exchange with executed trades.

poe.ninja dump values are daily LISTING-based estimates, not trades, and have no volume; thin items (Mirror, day 0-2 uniques) are noisy. Mirror quotes before day 7 are ignored; Kalandra's Mirror quotes were unusable.
Top orb switch at 3.19 Kalandra (Exalted -> Divine): ratio laws compare different orbs before and after.
Essence (2016) has item data only from day 48: excluded from item laws.
Group membership is by name/type rules in analyse.py; 'new league-mechanic loot' = names never priced before.
Settlers ran ~10 months (until 3.26); end-of-league measures use each league's real last day in the dump.
Steam player counts miss the standalone client; the hype index is relative only.
Liquidity could not be measured: the dumps have no volume or listing counts.
